# Earning over £100,000? Find out what the 60% band costs you, and what escaping it costs.

> Free UK 60% tax trap calculator for pay between £100,000 and £125,140: your real marginal rate, the pension contribution that restores your personal allowance and childcare, and what it truly costs after tax and NI. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
